description: The timestamp range includes scans stamped exactly at either endpoint.

b.request: For scans with `chronotag` text values inclusively between `'2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'` and `'2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'`, join to `sites` on `scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry` and exclude scans without a matching site; for each `sites.riskeval` status, calculate the average of `scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin`, ignoring rows where either value is missing, without rounding, and return each status alongside its average.
b.sql:
SELECT sites.riskeval, AVG(scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) AS average_gbsize_per_minute
FROM scans
JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
WHERE scans.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  AND scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL
  AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sites.riskeval;
b.raw: For scans with `chronotag` text values inclusively between `'2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'` and `'2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'`, join to `sites` on `scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry` and exclude scans without a matching site; for each `sites.riskeval` status, calculate the average of `scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin`, ignoring rows where either value is missing, without rounding, and return each status alongside its average.

d.request: Include scans with `chronotag` textually between or equal to `'2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'` and `'2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'`; inner join to `sites` on `scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry` so unmatched scans are excluded; group by `sites.riskeval` and return each status with the average of `gbsize ÷ spanmin`, ignoring rows where either value is missing, without rounding.
d.sql:
SELECT sites.riskeval, AVG(scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) AS avg_gbsize_per_spanmin
FROM scans
INNER JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
WHERE scans.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
  AND scans.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  AND scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL
  AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sites.riskeval;

a.request: Join each scan to its site (matching `scans.zoneref` to `sites.zoneregistry`, dropping scans with no matching site). Keep only scans whose `chronotag` lies between '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797', including both endpoints, comparing the values as plain text. For each site risk evaluation status (`sites.riskeval`), what is the average file size per scan minute (`gbsize` ÷ `spanmin`), ignoring missing values and without rounding? Show the status and that average.
a.sql: SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_file_size_per_scan_minute FROM scans AS sc INNER JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.riskeval;

c.request: For scans taken between '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (comparing `chronotag` as plain text), linked to their sites through `scans.zoneref` = `sites.zoneregistry` with unmatched scans left out, what is the average file size per scan minute (`gbsize` ÷ `spanmin`) for each site risk evaluation status (`sites.riskeval`)? Ignore missing values, don't round, and show the status next to its average. The timestamp range includes scans stamped exactly at either endpoint.
c.sql:
SELECT sites.riskeval, AVG(scans.gbsize / scans.spanmin) AS avg_file_size_per_scan_minute
FROM scans
JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
WHERE scans.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
  AND scans.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  AND scans.gbsize IS NOT NULL
  AND scans.spanmin IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sites.riskeval;
